workflows.name: high-agency-inbox-triage
workflows.prompt: Read the recent unread emails in Gmail. Classify them into bugs, billing, or inquiries. Draft high-fidelity replies for each, but do not send them. Log your triage decisions.
workflows.finish_line: All unread emails have drafted replies and are categorized in the log.
workflows.stop_rule: No remaining unread emails or iteration limit reached.

workflows.name: pr-to-ticket-sync
workflows.prompt: Scan open GitHub PRs. For each PR, locate the corresponding ticket in Jira or Linear. Sync the status (e.g. In Review, Merged) and add a reference comment to the ticket.
workflows.finish_line: All open PRs are synced with their corresponding issue tracker tickets.

workflows.name: firehose-filtering
workflows.prompt: Sweep slack/discord channels for high-importance keywords (e.g., 'breach', 'down', 'critical', 'fail'). Filter out normal chat noise and draft summary logs.
workflows.finish_line: High-importance alerts compiled and posted to escalation logs.

workflows.name: community-alert-system
workflows.prompt: Monitor developer and support channels. Identify unresolved user queries that have been open for more than 4 hours and flag them for human review.
workflows.finish_line: All stale queries identified and compiled in the review report.

workflows.name: ticket-drafting-loop
workflows.prompt: Analyze server error logs or crash reports. Automatically draft new bug tickets in Jira/Linear with stack trace, suspected cause, and files affected.
workflows.finish_line: Bug tickets created for all unique errors in the logs.

workflows.name: cold-outreach-pilot
workflows.prompt: Fetch hot leads from Salesforce. Draft personalized outbound emails based on their company description. Queue them for review.
workflows.finish_line: Outreach drafts created for all retrieved leads.

workflows.name: product-metrics-digest
workflows.prompt: Pull active user and retention metrics from PostHog. Summarize weekly growth and highlight any significant drop-offs in key onboarding funnels.
workflows.finish_line: Weekly metrics digest drafted with key trend highlights.

workflows.name: daily-runbook-execution
workflows.prompt: Execute standard database and system health runbooks. Check disk usage, verify backup status, and log diagnostic outcomes.
workflows.finish_line: All diagnostic checklist items verified and logged.

workflows.name: sla-breach-rescue
workflows.prompt: Scan open customer support tickets. Identify tickets approaching their SLA breach limit within 1 hour, and escalate priority in Opsgenie.
workflows.finish_line: All near-breach tickets escalated and assigned.

workflows.name: database-sanity-check
workflows.prompt: Run periodic Postgres sanity checks (e.g. check for orphaned subscriptions, invalid constraint values, or performance index bloat).
workflows.finish_line: Sanity check results cataloged in database-sanity-STATE.md.

workflows.name: compliance-checker
workflows.prompt: Scan documents in the shared Google Drive compliance folder. Verify they contain required clauses (e.g., GDPR, SOC2 compliance statements).
workflows.finish_line: All documents checked, and a compliance matrix updated.

workflows.name: vendor-spending-monitor
workflows.prompt: Analyze monthly transactions and vendor charges. Compare them to history and flag any charge that increased by more than 15% month-over-month.
workflows.finish_line: Monthly transaction variance report completed.

workflows.name: dynamic-copy-optimizer
workflows.prompt: Search the web for current industry trends using Exa. Review product landing page copy and suggest updates to align with trending terminology.
workflows.finish_line: landing_page_optimized.md copy variations created.

workflows.name: social-media-scheduler
workflows.prompt: Fetch approved social posts from the content backlog. Distribute them across scheduled time slots in Buffer.
workflows.finish_line: Next week's social buffer queue is fully populated.
workflows.stop_rule: All scheduled slots filled or queue empty.

workflows.name: newsletter-assembler
workflows.prompt: Assemble newsletter drafts by curating recent company updates, product releases, and top blog posts. Draft the weekly newsletter.
workflows.finish_line: Newsletter draft created in Substack.

workflows.name: competitor-release-tracker
workflows.prompt: Monitor competitor websites and blogs for product releases. Compile a brief of what features they added and how they position them.
workflows.finish_line: Competitor release intelligence report compiled.

workflows.name: search-console-analyst
workflows.prompt: Evaluate organic search console keywords. Identify keywords where position is between 11-20 (page 2) and draft targeted content improvements.
workflows.finish_line: Target keywords identified with optimization recommendations.

workflows.name: testimonial-harvester
workflows.prompt: Search X/Twitter for positive user testimonials, case studies, or praise about the product. Extract text and user handles.
workflows.finish_line: List of new user testimonials added to social proof vault.

workflows.name: overnight-intel-refresh
workflows.prompt: Run overnight crawls of tracked research papers or news sites. Compile a daily briefing document highlighting relevant technical shifts.
workflows.finish_line: Daily intel briefing file created and formatted.

workflows.name: regulatory-digest
workflows.prompt: Check regulatory agency websites for updates on industry guidelines. Extract key compliance modifications.
workflows.finish_line: Compliance digest updated with latest regulatory changes.

workflows.name: hard-question-escalation-queue
workflows.prompt: Route pending questions through cheap models. On failure or low-confidence indicators, escalate to Fable/high-capability models.
workflows.finish_line: All escalated questions answered and verified.

workflows.name: kill-criteria-loop
workflows.prompt: Track ongoing projects against their pre-defined kill criteria. Flag projects that have violated one or more of these criteria.
workflows.finish_line: Kill-criteria status updated for all active projects.

workflows.name: pre-mortem-loop
workflows.prompt: Read the proposed project design document. Draft detailed failure scenarios and pre-mortem hypotheses to harden the plan.
workflows.finish_line: Pre-mortem analysis report added as an appendix to the design doc.

workflows.name: repeat-offender-digest
workflows.prompt: Query the error tracking logs. Group errors by component/file and highlight repeat offender files where bugs keep reappearing.
workflows.finish_line: Repeat offender report generated with suggested refactor targets.

workflows.name: shadow-prompt-loop
workflows.prompt: Compare production input outputs between active prompt and candidate shadow prompt. Log disagreements to evaluate prompt upgrades.
workflows.finish_line: Shadow prompt analysis matrix generated.
